component.name: Tempo
component.summary: A light video editor that works like DaVinci Resolve's Edit page

description.p: Tempo is a simple video editor for ordinary laptops. It uses the same layout and keyboard shortcuts as DaVinci Resolve's Edit page, so what you learn here carries over when you move on. It needs no graphics card and never converts your footage on import.

ul.li: Cut, trim and arrange clips on up to four video and four audio tracks
Smooth preview on weak processors, with small proxies made in the background
Markers that become chapters in the exported file and in a copyable list

description.p: First release of the Rust rewrite.
